{{Nav Games Header|Completion}}
This page details the requirements for reaching 100% <b>completion</b> in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. The current completion percentage can be viewed in the menu after gaining and constructing the [[Farsight]].

== Trivia ==
* It is possible to reach an ending and complete Act 2 with a max of 93% completion. The 7% locked behind Act 3 are: a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask upgrade]], the [[Pale Steel Needle]] upgrade, [[Pin Badge]], [[Pale Nails]], [[Shaman Crest]], [[Silk Soar]], and [[Everbloom]].
